threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep looking for the 'last train' signs, not realizing they don't exist after 12am. Good luck finding a night bus in the rain!
Last night, the 227 rolled in 20 minutes late, and some bloke started singing 'Wonderwall' at the back. Oddly enough, everyone joined in. Nothing unites the late-night crowd like dodgy karaoke.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a group of kids making a makeshift skatepark in an empty lot, music blasting from a tiny speaker. Pure Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: I saw a guy at Görlitzer Park feeding pigeons with leftover Döner. They were practically lining up for it! Only in Berlin do even the pigeons get gourmet treatment.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local if they know the secret to avoid the BART delays—like skipping Civic Center when the train’s been acting up. It’s practically a survival skill.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 with a guy juggling flaming torches, while a saxophonist played smooth jazz. Only in the Tenderloin, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the best tapas are found in fancy spots; they miss the tiny bars where locals swap stories over a plate of olives.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look for the 'més' in the metro maps, confused by how close everything really is.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot newcomers by their shocked faces when a bus driver doesn't stop for them, even at a proper bus stop.
Caught a night bus home, and the driver had a plant behind the seat. Turns out it’s been there for months, thriving despite the chaos.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy using his bike to haul a full-size sofa down Karl-Marx-Strasse, I knew this place had a character all its own.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Here, it’s common to see a guy playing classical music on the subway while a girl sketches him. Only in Berlin do artists ride the public transport like it’s a stage.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who's local by how they navigate the BART delays. Newcomers just stand there bewildered, but the locals know to grab tacos and wait it out.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy bring his pet iguana onto the 14 Mission. Only in San Francisco, right? The bus driver didn’t even blink.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the terraces are for paella. Locals know most prefer a menú del dia at the hidden places only the neighborhood kids go.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still look for laundromats instead of embracing the 'lavadora' as a neighbor's prized possession in Gràcia.
